title: Chat answered from context and still started Coder
body: Owner, 2026-09-30 22:51, Mac app 716609e238, desktop: "What's the working directory right now?" got a full answer from the new surface context (#10077: "The current working directory is /Users/…/openagents-host-tasks"), and Coder **also** started ("Coder started on Codex…"). A reply that answers the question must not start Coder. Per #10073's precedence, the computer-lane reading starts Coder when no other typed action wins; now that the worker can answer local-state questions from context, that reading must not trigger a start for a question the reply answered. Fix the decision (typed, no keyword matching) in the shared rule, on the worker and/or client, with tests; recalibrate/redeploy the chat worker if the router changes (bounded Jev spend). Live check: "what's the working directory" on a desktop surface → answer only; "run the tests in this repo" → Coder starts.
